title: kbjob.py place asks the OPA placement policy where and as whom a job runs, and any failure to answer means the workstation
goal: kbjob.py place OP [SUBJECT] --opa URL builds the input {op, subject, roots, root_groups, operator, groups, host, capabilities: {paid, push}} and sends it as POST URL/v1/data/kbjobs/placement with urllib; it prints one JSON decision {executor, identity, fallback, fallback_after_s, budget_cap_usd, decided_by, reason}; an unreachable OPA, a reply with no result, or an executor, identity or fallback outside the tables (workstation|server|ci, none|group-bot|operator) gives executor workstation, identity none and a reason naming the cause, exit 0; without --opa it reads KB_OPA_URL, and with neither it decides workstation with the reason no policy

run:
import sys,os,json,time,tempfile,subprocess,threading,http.server
class H(http.server.BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
    seen=[]; out={}
    def do_POST(s):
        n=int(s.headers.get("Content-Length") or 0); H.seen.append((s.path,json.loads(s.rfile.read(n) or b"{}")))
        b=json.dumps(H.out).encode(); s.send_response(200); s.send_header("Content-Length",str(len(b))); s.end_headers(); s.wfile.write(b)
    def log_message(s,*a): pass
srv=http.server.HTTPServer(("127.0.0.1",0),H); threading.Thread(target=srv.serve_forever,daemon=True).start()
OPA=f"http://127.0.0.1:{srv.server_port}"
dec=lambda **k: {"result":dict({"executor":"workstation","identity":"none","fallback":None,"fallback_after_s":0,"budget_cap_usd":None,"decided_by":"default"},**k)}
d=tempfile.mkdtemp(); env=dict(os.environ,KB_COORD_STORE=os.path.join(d,"c.sqlite"))
kj=lambda *x,e=None: subprocess.run([sys.executable,"_tools/kbjob.py",*x],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=300,env=e or env)
p=lambda u: json.loads(kj("place","check","backlog-check","--opa",u).stdout)
H.out=dec(executor="server",identity="group-bot",decided_by="group:corp/ops"); d1=p(OPA)
H.out={}; d2=p(OPA)
H.out=dec(executor="moon"); d3=p(OPA)
d4=p("http://127.0.0.1:9")
assert d1["executor"]=="server" and d1["identity"]=="group-bot" and d1["decided_by"]=="group:corp/ops", d1
for x in (d2,d3,d4): assert x["executor"]=="workstation" and x["identity"]=="none" and x["reason"], x
path,body=H.seen[0]; assert path=="/v1/data/kbjobs/placement" and {"op","subject","operator","groups","host","capabilities"}<=set(body["input"]), H.seen[0]
